title: AURORA
_why: The seed piece's pose() is keyed to fixed frame numbers, so its BEATS cannot be re-timed from the audio. Narration is fitted INTO these slots instead: ids and ranges must stay byte-identical to the BEATS table in seed_aurora.html.
_word_budget: MEASURED: Algenib reads this preamble at ~1.25 words/s raw, and atempo can recover at most 1.15x, so the ceiling is ~1.44 words/s. Slot lengths at 24 fps are hook 6.0s, sun 10.0s, magneto 9.0s, precip 8.0s, colours 18.0s, payoff 6.0s, title 3.0s -- roughly 8/14/13/11/26/8/3 words. The first draft ran 175s of speech into a 60s picture; every segment overlapped the next. Sparse narration over a dense visual is the right trade here, not a defect.

narration.text: Nothing up there is burning. The sky is a neon sign.
It starts at the sun. A wind of charged particles, four days out.
Earth has a magnetic shield. It turns that wind aside, but it leaks at the poles.
Electrons pour down. Each stops where the air finally thickens.

That is what picks the colour. Nitrogen answers instantly, in violet. Oxygen waits three quarters of a second for green. The red line waits two minutes, so it only glows where the sky is nearly empty.
Same air. Same electrons. Different waiting times.
